dialect.detail: IBM mainframe CICS online transaction program, converted by COBOL Conversion Aid (PO 5785-ABJ) in 1996, authored by Logic, Inc., Dallas TX. Uses EXEC CICS, COMP-3, fixed format, VSAM-style keyed file access (ERPYAJ, ERCOMP files).
evidence: XCTL/LINK to other programs (EL005, EL010, EL626, EL652)
DFH-START PIC X(04) - DFH prefix typical of CICS

purpose.domain_detail: Compensation payments and adjustments processing for an insurance carrier system (Logic, Inc.). Handles GL account validation for multiple carriers (DCC, CSI, CCC, CID, VPP, FNL), compensation master file updates, and CICS screen transaction EXB8.
purpose.summary: This is a CICS online transaction program (transaction EXB8) for processing compensation payments and adjustments in an insurance system. It validates GL account numbers for various carrier types (DCC, CSI, CCC, CID, VPP, FNL), reads/writes compensation and payment adjustment files (ERCOMP, ERPYAJ), and manages security and screen display logic. The program has been actively maintained from 1996 through 2021.

notable_features: Extensive GL account number validation with 88-level condition names
Change log spanning 1996-2021 with change request numbers
XCTL and LINK to multiple programs
verdict.notes: Source was truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 4195 lines. Copybooks (ELCSCTM, ELCSCRTY) appear to have been inlined rather than copied at compile time. Line sequence numbers use non-standard prefixes (CIDMOD, 060205, 031710, etc.) reflecting the change log convention. Decoded with latin-1 encoding.
